name: Root-Skills
version: '${version}'
main: com.rootrecord.minecraft.rootskills.RootSkillsPlugin
api-version: '26.1'
description: RootMC skills, talents, classes, and prestige (mcMMO-style)
author: Root Record
website: https://rootmc.net
softdepend: [Vault, PlaceholderAPI, Root-Economy, Root-Claims, Towny]
commands:
  skills:
    description: Open skills hub or view skill progress
    usage: /skills [skill]
    aliases: [skill]
  talents:
    description: View and manage talents
    usage: /talents [skill]
  class:
    description: View or select a class
    usage: /class [info|select] [name]
    aliases: [classes]
  rootskills:
    description: Root-Skills admin commands
    usage: /rootskills <reload|xp|level|migrate|...>
    permission: rootskills.admin
permissions:
  rootskills.use:
    description: Use skills commands and earn XP
    default: true
  rootskills.admin:
    description: Admin Root-Skills
    default: op
  rootskills.reload:
    description: Reload Root-Skills config
    default: op

# Root-Skills — primary config

mysql:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 3306
  user: root
  password: ''
  database: rootmc
  pool:
    maximum-pool-size: 10
    minimum-idle: 2
    connection-timeout-ms: 10000
    idle-timeout-ms: 600000
    max-lifetime-ms: 1800000

table-prefix: root_skills_

  exponent: 2.05
  base: 2800
  cumulative: true

  classes: true
  prestige: true
  boosters: true
  parties: true

4. **Talents** — YAML load, TriggerBus, EffectRunner core effects, mana regen, SHIFT+F loadout GUI  
5. **Prestige / boosters / classes / parties** — wired with commands  
6. **API** — `getPowerLevel`, `setLevel`, `getMana`, `getClassId`, `getPrestige`

### Gaps for RootMC cutover (not done here)
- RootMC core softdepend / integration  
- Live MySQL credentials in handoff `config.yml`
